items.source: Spring annotations are meta-annotated with JSR 305 annotations (a dormant but widely used JSR). JSR 305 meta-annotations let tooling vendors (such as IDEA, Eclipse, and Kotlin) provide null-safety support in a generic way, without having to hard-code support for Spring annotations. To enable runtime checking of nullability constraints for query methods, you need to activate non-nullability on the package level by using Spring’s @NonNullApi in package-info.java, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: Spring 注解使用 JSR 305 元注解（一个虽已休眠但广泛使用的 JSR）进行标记。 JSR 305 元注解允许工具供应商（如 IDEA、Eclipse 和 Kotlin）以通用方式提供空安全支持，而无需为 Spring 注解硬编码特定支持。 若要启用查询方法中可空性约束的运行时检查，您需要通过在 package-info.java 中使用 Spring 的 @NonNullApi 在包级别激活非空性，示例如下：

items.source: @NonNull: Used on a type level for parameter or return values that must not be null (not needed on parameters and return values already covered by @NullMarked).
items.translation: @NonNull：用于类型级别，表示参数或返回值不能为null（对于已由@NullMarked覆盖的参数和返回值则不需要）。

items.source: @NonNull and @NullUnmarked should rarely be needed for typical use cases.
items.translation: @NonNull 和 @NullUnmarked 在典型用例中很少需要用到。

items.source: @NonNull: Used on a parameter or return value that must not be null (not needed on a parameter and return value where @NonNullApi applies).
items.translation: @NonNull：用于必须不为null的参数或返回值（在应用@NonNullApi的参数和返回值上不需要）。

items.source: Alternatively, query methods can choose not to use a wrapper type at all. The absence of a query result is then indicated by returning null. Repository methods returning collections, collection alternatives, wrappers, and streams are guaranteed never to return null but rather the corresponding empty representation. See “Repository query return types” for details.
items.translation: 或者，查询方法可以完全不使用包装类型。此时，无查询结果的情况通过返回 null 来表示。 对于返回集合、集合替代项、包装类型和流的方法，仓库方法保证绝不会返回 null，而是返回相应的空表示形式。 有关详细信息，请参阅“仓库查询返回类型"。

items.source: @NullMarked: Used on the module-, package- and class-level to declare that the default behavior for parameters and return values is, respectively, neither to accept nor to produce null values.
items.translation: @NullMarked：用于模块、包和类级别，声明参数和返回值的默认行为分别是既不接收也不产生 null 值。

items.source: @Nullable: Used on the type level for parameter or return values that can be null.
items.translation: @Nullable：用于类型级别，表示参数或返回值可能为null。

items.source: @NullUnmarked: Used on the package-, class-, and method-level to roll back nullness declaration and opt-out from a previous @NullMarked. Nullness changes to unspecified in such a case.
items.translation: @NullUnmarked：用于包、类和方法级别，以回滚空值声明并退出之前的 @NullMarked 状态。在此情况下，空值性将变为未指定。

items.source: The Java specifications also enforces that annotations defined with @Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE) like JSpecify @Nullable should be specified after the last . with inner or fully qualified types:
items.translation: Java 规范还强制规定，使用 `@Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE)` 定义的注解（如 JSpecify 的 `@Nullable`）必须位于最后一个 `.` 之后，用于内层或完全限定类型：

items.source: @NonNullApi: Used on the package level to declare that the default behavior for parameters and return values is, respectively, neither to accept nor to produce null values.
items.translation: @NonNullApi：在包级别使用，用于声明参数和返回值的默认行为分别是既不接受也不产生 null 值。

items.source: @Nullable: Used on a parameter or return value that can be null.
items.translation: @Nullable：用于参数或返回值可能为null的情况。

items.source: In the various Java files belonging to the package, nullable type usages are defined explicitly with @Nullable. It is recommended that this annotation is specified just before the related type.
items.translation: 在包中的各个 Java 文件中，可空类型的使用通过显式定义 @Nullable 来标识。建议将此注解放在相关类型的正前方。

items.source: Once non-null defaulting is in place, repository query method invocations get validated at runtime for nullability constraints. If a query result violates the defined constraint, an exception is thrown. This happens when the method would return null but is declared as non-nullable (the default with the annotation defined on the package in which the repository resides). If you want to opt-in to nullable results again, selectively use @Nullable on individual methods. Using the result wrapper types mentioned at the start of this section continues to work as expected: an empty result is translated into the value that represents absence.
items.translation: 启用非空默认值后，仓库查询方法的调用将在运行时针对可空性约束进行验证。 如果查询结果违反了定义的约束，将抛出异常。 这种情况发生在方法本应返回 `null` 但其被声明为非空时（这是通过定义在仓库所在包上的注解所设定的默认行为）。 如果您希望再次选择允许可空结果，可以针对各个方法有选择地使用 `@Nullable` 注解。 本节开头提到的结果包装类型继续按预期工作：空结果将被转换为表示缺失的值。

items.source: Kotlin has the definition of nullability constraints baked into the language. Kotlin code compiles to bytecode, which does not express nullability constraints through method signatures but rather through compiled-in metadata. Make sure to include the kotlin-reflect JAR in your project to enable introspection of Kotlin’s nullability constraints. Spring Data repositories use the language mechanism to define those constraints to apply the same runtime checks, as follows:
items.translation: Kotlin 将空值约束的定义内置于语言之中。 Kotlin 代码编译为字节码，该方法签名不表达空值约束，而是通过编译时嵌入的元数据来表达。 请确保在项目中包含 kotlin-reflect JAR，以启用对 Kotlin 空值约束的内省功能。 Spring Data 仓库利用语言机制来定义这些约束，以便应用相同的运行时检查，如下所示：

items.source: @Nullable Object[] array means individual elements can be null but the array itself can’t.
items.translation: @Nullable Object[] array 表示数组中的各个元素可以为 null，但数组本身不能为 null。

items.source: Object @Nullable [] array means individual elements can’t be null but the array itself can.
items.translation: Object @Nullable [] array 表示数组本身可以为 null，但其各个元素不能为 null。

items.source: @Nullable Object @Nullable [] array means both individual elements and the array can be null.
items.translation: @Nullable Object @Nullable [] array 表示数组本身及其各个元素都可为 null。

When overriding a method, nullness annotations are not inherited from the superclass method.
That means those nullness annotations should be repeated if you just want to override the implementation and keep the same API nullness.

items.source: 1 The repository resides in a package (or sub-package) for which we have defined non-null behavior. 2 Throws an EmptyResultDataAccessException when the query does not produce a result. Throws an IllegalArgumentException when the emailAddress handed to the method is null. 3 Returns null when the query does not produce a result. Also accepts null as the value for emailAddress. 4 Returns Optional.empty() when the query does not produce a result. Throws an IllegalArgumentException when the emailAddress handed to the method is null.
items.translation: 1 仓库位于一个已定义非空行为的包（或子包）中。 2 当查询未产生结果时，抛出 EmptyResultDataAccessException。 当传递给方法的 emailAddress 为 null 时，抛出 IllegalArgumentException。 3 当查询未产生结果时，返回 null。 同时也接受 null 作为 emailAddress 的值。 4 当查询未产生结果时，返回 Optional.empty()。 当传递给方法的 emailAddress 为 null 时，抛出 IllegalArgumentException。
